findings.text: `core/Session/Chat/doc/pseudo-properties.md:46` (step 6) still says "a `partial` file waits for the fill-in above", but the fill-in is now built (step 2 ✅). It should say: `--apply` on every file the compare finds `none` or `partial`.
`core/Session/Chat/readme.md:13`, the class map, still reads `Sentence { text, via, at, raw? }`. It should add `said_at?`, which the diff adds in `Sentence.js` and `ChatWriter.js:58`.

`Server/ChatToMessages.mjs` plan(), in the block after "The fast seat's {place} improves", rebuilds the `{place}` → `clean` line by hand. `ChatWriter` already makes that line (`Servex/agents/ChatWriter.js:115-123`). That gives two writers for one line shape (Law 6). The fill should call the writer's own place method, as it already does with `writer.mirror()`.

`Server/ChatToMessages.test.mjs`, section 3: the check labelled "a complete file adds nothing" asserts `.length >= 0`, which is always true, so it proves nothing. The real idempotence checks in sections 2 and 4 cover it, so either drop the line or make it `=== 0`.

`Server/ChatToMessages.test.mjs`, section 4, reads the real `2026/11/01/v-u48msei/session.jsonl`. It only reads the file, but if that session is still live, new lines can break the "0 differing bubbles" check later. A frozen copy under `core/Session/Chat/fixture/` would be steadier, and the brief asked for "a copy of a real session".

`Server/ChatToMessages.mjs` plan() declares `let mid = null;` and never uses it. `mid_of` also does a linear `[...sid_of].find` for every output line (O(n²)). That is fine at 2,381 lines but worth a reverse map.

Step 1 changed only `ChatWriter.owner()`. That is enough, because `Sessions.say()`/`line()` both go through `chat_writer.mirror()` (`Servex/agents/Sessions.js:269`, `:612`). Live sessions get `said_at` only after a Servex restart, which `pseudo-properties.md` step 4 already says. Nobody has restarted Servex yet.

To reach 0 diffs, `V1Bubbles.chat_events` now applies `{place}` improves on the V1 side. V1's renderer is outside the fence, so it is not checked here. Confirm this matches `ext/Chat/Chat.js`'s in-place fix exactly: an adapter-side guess that is wrong on both sides would still show 0.

`public/framework/core/Session/Chat/readme.md:97` says `node Server/ChatToMessages.test.mjs` runs "12 checks", but it prints "11 checks passed" (run in the worktree, 2026-11-02). Fix the number, or drop it so it cannot go stale.

`Servex/agents/ChatWriter.js:115-121`: the new `clean_line()` and its `/** */` comment were put between `place()`'s doc comment and `place()`. Now `place()` has no comment of its own, and its four-line description sits above `clean_line`. Move `clean_line` (with its comment) above `place()`'s comment block.

All four asks are met, and I checked them in the worktree. ChatWriter copies `said_at` onto the Sentence (`ChatWriter.js:58`). `plan()` fills a partly mirrored file without twins, and planning it again adds nothing. `ChatV1Compare.mjs` gives 0 differing bubbles on all 5 sessions, the same numbers as `compare-after.txt`. The plan doc and readme ⬜ items are updated, and the fences held: no edits to Widget.js or Chat.js, and no `--apply`. The first review's fixes 1–3 are done.

The "0 differing bubbles" are counted against `V1Bubbles.from_chat_lines`, a model of V1, not against V1 itself. The new `{place}` handling in `V1Bubbles.js:224-225` only copies the improved text. V1's `Widget.place()` (`ux/Dictate/Widget.js:584`) also splits the bubble when `to` is "paragraph" or "card", and neither side models that. Check those splits before step 4 switches Widget.js over.

`V1Bubbles.js:213` reads `m.said_at` on a Message, but Message and Reply have no `said_at` getter, and ChatWriter never writes one on a reply. So the read is always undefined and harmless. No reply `{chat}` line in v-sq8y7db or v-9dvbbrn has a `said_at` (grep: 0 non-owner lines), so nothing is lost. Either drop the read or add the getter.

`Server/ChatToMessages.test.mjs:132`: the comment says "a complete file adds nothing", but the check only covers the nothing-mirrored case. The idempotence checks at :130 and :138 already prove the complete-file case, so the comment should say that.

Test section 4 still reads the real `2026/11/01/v-u48msei/session.jsonl` instead of a frozen copy (the first review's note 5). Its last commit was 2026-11-01 21:52, so it looks finished, but a fixture copy would keep the test from breaking if that session ever grows.
Live sessions write `said_at` only after Servex restarts (`pseudo-properties.md` step 4 says so). After this merges, someone has to restart Servex, or new lines keep coming without it.

The Chat, Prompt.raw and V1Bubbles tests pass. `node Server/ChatV1Compare.mjs` finds 0 differing bubbles on all 5 sessions, the same numbers as `compare-after.txt`.

Both fixes from the second review are done. The readme's check count is now right, and `clean_line()` sits above `place()`'s comment block (`Servex/agents/ChatWriter.js:115`). The fences held: the diff doesn't touch `Widget.js` or `ext/Chat/Chat.js`, and nothing ran `--apply`.

Test section 4 (`ChatToMessages.test.mjs:41`) reads the real `2026/11/01/v-u48msei/session.jsonl`, not a frozen copy. If that session grows, the "0 differing bubbles" check could break later.
